open_points.subject: M23 NodeExecution identity
open_points.text: "## Model M23 — NodeExecution ... The trace record of one concluded attempt ..." + "Identity: value" + "Identity evidence: Substitution: an attempt's record is issued once."
open_points.question: Is NodeExecution intended to be an entity (one issued event record per attempt) or a content-derived value (deduplicated by meaning facts)?
options: Entity identity (minted per node attempt, even if meaning facts match another record)
Value identity (derived from meaning facts; equal facts collapse to one record)
open_points.default_guess: Entity identity, because it is described as an issued trace record of one attempt.

open_points.subject: EffectApproval authority after request mismatch
open_points.text: "An approved, unused approval whose request_digest no longer matches the request about to be sent stays approved and unused and is simply no authority for that send; the kernel then sends under an active grant when one applies, otherwise requests a new approval"
open_points.question: When a mismatched approved approval is bypassed by an active standing grant, is that original approval expected to remain forever in status `approved`, or must it eventually transition (for example to an explicit terminal status) when the run ends?
options: Transition to a distinct terminal non-used status at run end
Transition to `used` is forbidden unless its exact request_digest is sent
open_points.default_guess: Keep it as `approved` and unused permanently, since no additional status is defined.

open_points.subject: M10/M28 manifest read timing vs binding drift checks
open_points.text: M28: "manifest_revision ... a record changes for the kernel only when the owner changes the configured revision"; M10 meaning: "Read ... every time the operation is invoked, to check that the manifest record still has the pinned digest"
open_points.question: Should invocation-time digest checks observe only the configured fixed revision snapshot, or live manifest changes at the same location without revision reconfiguration?
options: Checks use only the configured revision snapshot
Checks observe live manifest content at invocation time
open_points.default_guess: Use only the configured revision snapshot, with drift appearing only after configuration revision change.
